title: PF-Exec: Large-Scale UAV Relay Load Balancing with an Anchored Potential Direction Decider and a Per-Dimension Gain-Learning Executor
abstract: arXiv:2611.17492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relay load balancing in large-scale UAV networks requires joint decisions on association, bandwidth, power and hovering position, while the dimension grows with the number of UAVs and each UAV sees only its local state. This paper splits the decision into two layers. An anchored potential direction decider emits a closed-form target at every instant and returns its direction only. A gain-learning executor maps a local observation into a positive gain per dimension, composes gain and target, and clips the action against the physical single-step bound; the two layers form PF-Exec. The unit gain is the default start, so the executor reduces to the pure potential policy before training. The load is first-order homogeneous in bandwidth, making the bandwidth target closed form, and the position target is the demand-weighted centroid of the served users. translated_title: PF-Exec：基于锚定势能方向决策器与逐维度增益学习执行器的大规模无人机中继负载均衡
translated_abstract: 大规模无人机网络中的中继负载均衡需要对关联、带宽、功率和悬停位置进行联合决策，而决策维度随无人机数量增长，且每架无人机只能观测到其局部状态。本文将决策拆分为两层：锚定势能方向决策器在每一时刻输出一个闭式目标，并仅返回其方向；增益学习执行器将局部观测映射为每个维度的正增益，将增益与目标组合，并把动作限制在物理单步界限内；这两层共同构成 PF-Exec。单位增益是默认起始值，因此在训练之前，执行器退化为纯势能策略。负载对带宽是一阶齐次的，使得带宽目标具有闭式形式，而位置目标则是所服务用户的按需求加权质心。系统采用两跳接入与毫米波回传链路以及软关联机制……
tldr: 提出两层决策框架 PF-Exec：锚定势能方向决策器每时刻输出闭式目标方向，逐维度增益学习执行器将局部观测映射为各维度增益以自适应调节动作幅度，从而在大规模无人机中继网络中实现关联、带宽、功率与位置的联合负载均衡。
en_tdlr: PF-Exec is a two-layer decision framework in which an anchored potential direction decider emits closed-form target directions and a per-dimension gain-learning executor adaptively scales actions from local observations, enabling joint relay load balancing over association, bandwidth, power and hovering position in large-scale UAV networks.
